notes: Category codes used in variants ('U18 M', 'U18 W', 'U20 M', 'U20 W', 'Men', 'Women') match the built-in swiss-athletics category scheme 1:1 for these tiers (Swiss Athletics adopts the WA Rule 3 U18/U20/Senior boundaries verbatim, D4.1/D4.2). Implement-mass variants (shot/discus/hammer/javelin) are sourced from a secondary compilation of World Athletics/area-federation technical specifications (see per-variant citation) pending direct verification against the primary CR&TR Part III text, which could not be extracted cleanly in this pass (binary/OCR-less PDF). Senior hurdle height/spacing figures are sourced from a secondary compilation explicitly citing 'World Athletics Rule 22.1 (2026)'. U16/U18/U20/Masters hurdle-height variants are NOT populated (the only clean secondary source available used UK Athletics age-group conventions — U13/U15/U17/U20 — that do not map 1:1 onto the WA/Swiss U16/U18/U20 categories used by this project, so no variant is recorded rather than guessing); this is an explicit open item for the tech lead / a follow-up data task, not a silent gap — see docs/requirements/open-questions-and-assumptions.md.
